rationale: The agent properly verified identity using full name and zip, matched to a single account, and operated only on that user’s orders. They reviewed the order details, clarified which vacuum to return, summarized the exact changes (returning the air purifier and the canister vacuum with refund to the original PayPal method), and obtained explicit confirmation before performing the return. The return tool call targeted the correct order and item IDs, and the status updated to return requested. The agent provided accurate refund totals based on item prices and correctly computed the remaining items’ total, matching the order’s payment. When asked for a 3-day refund, the agent appropriately avoided guarantees and noted a typical processing window. No unsupported claims or policy violations were observed; no writes occurred without confirmation, and no cross-account actions took place.
